# Official Wintun prebuilt DLL

Source: https://www.wintun.net/builds/wintun-0.14.1.zip

- `amd64/wintun.dll` — x86_64
- `arm64/wintun.dll` — aarch64
- `LICENSE.txt` — Prebuilt Binaries License (WireGuard LLC)

Not GPLv2 source. AGG loads the DLL via `wintun.h` (Permitted API) and may ship it next to the exe.
